title: Ratchet family file (contracts §12, 2.1-M186)
description: One file per rule family in policy/ratchets/, named <family>.json. A named family lists its violations under entries; a count family holds one count. policy/check.mjs validates every family file against this schema with a validator that refuses any keyword it does not implement.

tool.description: The tool that reports this family's sites. Its adapter, policy/adapters/<tool>.mjs, turns the tool's output into the sites compare() takes; policy/check.mjs refuses a tool with no adapter, so a tool joins with its adapter and this schema lists none (2.1-M189).
